hypotheses.S0_native_suffix_recomposition_is_exact: Independent native prefix and suffix execution agree to relative context-coordinate error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.S1_full_state_trace_replicates: Overlapping full-state mean and cyclic fidelities differ from the parent trace by at most 0.10 on every corpus and boundary.
hypotheses.S2_router_subspace_is_causally_relevant_: At Layer 16, cyclic replacement in the fitted router input span produces at least half the operator-fidelity loss of full-state cyclic replacement on every corpus.
hypotheses.S3_router_subspace_beats_random_at_layer: At Layer 16, cyclic router-subspace replacement is at least 0.10 more damaging than matched random-subspace replacement on every corpus.
hypotheses.S4_early_predictive_span_is_recoverable: At Layer 4, cyclic router-subspace replacement retains at least 0.90 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.S5_compilation_curve_is_gradual: Across consecutive Blocks 4 through 10, the largest one-layer drop in full-state mean-replacement fidelity is at most 0.12 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S6_single_boundary_is_threshold_dependen: For every corpus, the first crossings of 0.95, 0.90, and 0.80 full-state mean-replacement fidelity are not all the same tested boundary.
hypotheses.S7_strict_commitment_depth_is_corpus_dep: The first 0.80 crossing differs by at least four layers across corpora.
hypotheses.S8_router_span_fraction_grows_with_depth: The fraction of full cyclic loss explained by the router subspace is larger at Layer 16 than Layer 4 on every corpus.
hypotheses.S9_random_subspace_is_not_equally_causal: Averaged across all tested layers, router-subspace cyclic loss exceeds random-subspace cyclic loss on every corpus.
